clips.title: Drag bread on a spatula
clips.caption: Without point dynamics, the bread stays on the plate as the spatula moves away.

clips.title: Release a cup
clips.caption: Without point dynamics, the released cup rises with the open gripper.

clips.title: Carry a cup
clips.caption: Without point dynamics, the cup is left on the tray.

clips.title: Hang a cloth
clips.caption: Without point dynamics, the cloth slides off.

clips.title: Lift a towel
clips.caption: Without point dynamics, the towel bunches up.

clips.title: Unfold a bag
clips.caption: Without point dynamics, the bag is not unfolded.

clips.title: Carry a bag
clips.caption: Without point dynamics, the bag does not swing.

clips.title: Hand over a bag
clips.caption: Without point dynamics, the bag hangs from the wrong arm or appears twice.

clips.title: Hand over a pillow
clips.caption: With the proxy, the pillow’s shape and position stay closest to the real handover.

clips.title: Place a cuboid on a plate
clips.caption: With the numeric action, the cuboid appears twice.
